title: DBGuardAI check manifest contract (version 1)
description: Contract for a check manifest: a plain JSON list of checks the collector must look up, derived from CIS control specs. The manifest is data only and never contains SQL built from spec text.

manifest_version.description: The manifest schema version. Must be 1.

benchmark_id.description: The benchmark identifier that these checks belong to (e.g., 'cis-pg17-v1.1.0').

checks.description: List of check entries. Each check corresponds to one automated spec.

check_entry.description: A single check entry derived from a spec.

spec_id.description: The spec_id that this check corresponds to.

spec_hash.description: The SHA-256 hash of the spec file (as computed by spec_sha256).

kind.description: The kind of check. Currently only 'setting' is supported.

setting_name.description: The PostgreSQL GUC parameter name being checked. Must match pattern ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*$.

query.description: The SQL query to execute to gather the current value. Currently always 'SHOW <setting_name>'.
